blocks.title: EffectCraft: draw here, or let the agent draw with you
blocks.description: Sketch effect beats as layered shapes and type on a canvas, ready to export or hand to the agent.

items.title: Five kinds of object, one canvas
items.description: Rectangles, ellipses, lines, text and images live in one document; the order is the stacking.

items.title: Snapping and alignment
items.description: Drag along the guides, and align, centre or distribute a multi-selection in one click.

items.title: Export PNG or document JSON
items.description: Render the current canvas to an image, or save the document so it can be reopened later.

items.title: The conversation edits it
items.description: Inserting shapes, changing properties, aligning and saving are semantic operations, not pixel hunting.

showcase.user_prompt: Open a canvas in EffectCraft, draw three title blocks, left-align them and export a PNG.
showcase.assistant_reply: Three rectangles are in place, equal width and top-aligned. Export renders the current canvas — want the fill switched to the theme blue first?

items.title: Open the {name} tab
items.description: A new canvas with a Chinese interface by default.

items.title: Pick an object from the left rail
items.description: Drop a rectangle, ellipse or text, then adjust colour and size in the inspector.

items.title: Keep talking in the conversation
items.description: "align the three blocks left", "add a heading", "export a PNG" — the agent edits the same document.

items.title: Export when you need a file
items.description: Autosave stays inside the plugin; PNG and JSON go wherever you choose.

blocks.content: This plugin ships its own drawing engine: nothing is downloaded and no external app is loaded. Open the tab and it is there; close it and it stops.
